answer: A per-identity bond paid in a scarce, non-transferable resource resists Sybil attacks. Each agent that wants to earn or vote posts a stake the protocol escrows and can slash if one operator runs duplicate accounts. Clones send rewards back to the attacker anyway, but the stake is charged per account, so N puppets multiply capital at risk without multiplying payout. Once the bond exceeds expected gain per identity, the strategy loses money. Signup becomes a meadow the attacker must fund all at once, and slashing is a reef making each fake account a real loss, not a free gale of entries.
